WITH per_telescope AS (
  SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse_rate
  FROM signals
  GROUP BY telescref
),
first_baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS baseline
  FROM per_telescope
),
first_kept AS (
  SELECT p.telescref, p.avg_pulse_rate, b.baseline AS first_baseline
  FROM per_telescope AS p
  CROSS JOIN first_baseline AS b
  WHERE p.avg_pulse_rate > b.baseline
),
second_baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS baseline
  FROM first_kept
),
final_kept AS (
  SELECT f.avg_pulse_rate, f.first_baseline, b.baseline AS second_baseline
  FROM first_kept AS f
  CROSS JOIN second_baseline AS b
  WHERE f.avg_pulse_rate > b.baseline
)
SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS mean_avg_pulse_rate,
       AVG(avg_pulse_rate - first_baseline) AS mean_excess_over_first_baseline,
       AVG(avg_pulse_rate - second_baseline) AS mean_excess_over_second_baseline
FROM final_kept;

assumptions.assumption: Telescopes are those represented by at least one signals row; AVG ignores NULL pulse rates, and a telescope with no non-NULL pulse rates has a NULL average and is excluded from the baselines and subsequent comparisons.
